lastCompletedStory.title: Wire issue-list to readIssueSystem and sweep remaining 'none' fixtures

openQuestions: scripts/build-release.sh AC4 smoke still passes '--issue-system none' to the compiled binary (carried over from US-001/US-002; still not in scope -- US-004 is docs/templates/project.toml, not build-release.sh).

scripts/cam/patterns.md:46 (the finalizeCycleClose hardening bullet) still says "issue_system == 'none'" -- it is a knowledge doc, not a code path, so it was out of AC scope for US-003 and is explicitly flagged out-of-scope for US-004 too (per US-004's own notes field); a follow-up story should update that bullet's prose to 'local' for consistency.

src/config/issue-system.ts's own doc comment (written in US-002) initially failed the AC2 grep oracle because a backtick-fenced `'none'` inside a doc comment still matches the literal grep pattern; fixed this story by rewording to avoid the quote pair. Worth remembering for any future 'no occurrences of X' oracle: grep matches substrings inside comments/docstrings just as much as inside code.
nextStoryContext: US-004 is next: migrate scripts/cam/project.toml, templates/commands/cam-issue.md + .claude/commands/cam-issue.md (dual-copy, per patterns.md's cam-dual-copy-is-per-file bullet), templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md + .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md, and docs/recovery-runbook.md from 'none' to 'local', plus a CHANGELOG breaking-rename note (the only place 'none' should still appear). Both template and installed .claude/ copies must be edited AND src/vendor/_generated.ts regenerated via `bun run embed-vendor` (embed-vendor:check is a mandatory gate for that story since it touches vendor/templates). Known ship gotcha called out in US-004's own notes: the currently-installed cam binary still compares === 'none', so this PR's own ship --finalize may read 'local' from project.toml and skip the local issue-file close for CAM-236 -- the operator may need to close the issue file manually or rebuild+reinstall the binary before shipping this PRD. All production code paths (src/commands/setup.ts, src/ui/SetupScreen.tsx, src/commands/ship-finalize.ts, src/release/ship-pr.ts, src/commands/issue-list.ts, src/config/issue-system.ts) and all test fixtures are now clean of the string literal 'none' as of US-003 -- US-004 is purely docs/templates/project.toml/CHANGELOG, no further src/ or test/ changes expected.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal wiring: issue-list.ts switched from an inline loose-typed issue_system read + implicit else-fallthrough to readIssueSystem() (added in US-002) with an explicit === 'local' branch, plus a doc-comment fix in issue-system.ts and a codebase-wide test-fixture rename ('none' -> 'local'). No new external library API surface was exercised.
